tools.name: untappd_brewery_beers
tools.description: Get the beers a brewery makes, by brewery id, with per-beer global rating, check-in count, ABV, style and in_production. Supports sorting and paging. Get an id from untappd_search_brewery. Lists are CACHED locally for 7 days (source:"cache"|"api", fetched_at, expires_at): a fresh cached list answers without an API call — the default popularity order from the cached top-of-list, other sorts once the whole list is cached (sorted locally). refresh:true re-fetches. The compact result has the same keys with or without the cache (source:"api" and null fetched_at/expires_at when no cache is available), with pagination {offset, limit, next_offset}. Untappd's per-beer has_had / your-count on this endpoint describe the AUTHENTICATED account, never the user you are asking about, so have_had / your_count are never cached or returned on either path — use untappd_cache_has_had_many for any user. With the cache, the result carries favorite {is_favorite, sources, reason} for the brewery and on each favorite beer (derived from username's history or added with untappd_favorite_add; default your account). view:"full" always calls Untappd and returns its raw page. Read-only.

tools.name: untappd_venue_menu
tools.description: Return a venue's verified beer menu as a flat, compact list of beers. untappd_venue_info returns only the FIRST section of each menu (Untappd defaults the section list to one), so it silently under-reports any venue whose menu spans multiple sections — e.g. a 23-beer wall that comes back with 2 items. This tool forwards the section_limit / section_offset paging params venue/info echoes back but never receives, walks sections up to a per-call max_pages budget (respecting the ~100 calls/hour limit — it does NOT loop to completion in one call), and flattens to [{bid, name, brewery, brewery_id, style, abv, price, serving_type, menu, section}]. Like the sync tools it is resumable: when the budget runs out before full coverage it returns another_run_needed:true plus next_section_offset to pass back on the next call. truncated:true means the upstream returned no more sections short of total_count (e.g. it ignored the paging params) — not resumable. Results are cached locally for 6 hours per venue + paging params (cache.hit, fetched_at, expires_at) so repeated trip planning does not re-spend calls; refresh:true re-fetches. With the cache, the result also carries favorite {is_favorite, sources, reason} for the venue, and favorite / brewery_favorite on each beer that is one (derived from username's history or added with untappd_favorite_add; default your account) — applied on read, so never stale. Get an id from untappd_search_venue. Read-only.

menu_id.description: Restrict to a single menu id (from a prior result). Optional.

section_limit.description: Sections fetched per API call — page size (default 50).

section_offset.description: Section offset to start from; pass a prior next_section_offset to resume (default 0).

max_pages.description: API calls to spend THIS run — page budget, not page size (default 3). Resume with next_section_offset if another_run_needed.

refresh.description: Bypass the 6-hour local cache and call Untappd (default false)

username.description: Whose favorites to mark (cache only; default your configured account)

tools.name: untappd_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify Untappd connectivity and that credentials are configured and can log in. Performs a lightweight authenticated request (your recent feed) and reports whether it succeeded, plus the running server version and the exact set of tools this build exposes (count, a stable hash, and their names) so you can confirm which build is live. Read-only.

tools.name: untappd_cache_status
tools.description: Diagnostics for the LOCAL check-in cache — NO API call. Returns the resolved cache file path, its size on disk (db + WAL), journal mode, schema version, the number of cached menu-line resolutions and beer-metadata rows, cached venues, and for every cached user: cached vs total distinct beers, cached check-ins, coverage_complete, the resume offset of an unfinished user/beers backfill, last_synced_at, and venue-history coverage (venues: cached vs total, complete, percent, next_offset; null if never synced), wishlist and Untappd brewery-likes mirror coverage (wishlist / brewery_likes: cached vs total, complete; null if never synced). Also reports rate_limit: API calls made in the last hour (this process plus any other sharing the cache file), the ~100/hour limit, the estimated calls left, the raw X-Ratelimit-* headers (the v4 API sends Remaining: 0 on every success, so it is ignored until it reports a live value) and any 429 wait. Use it to confirm the cache persisted across restarts, to see how far a backfill has got, or to check whether a sync can run now.

annotations.title: Show the local cache location, schema and per-user coverage

tools.name: untappd_sync_checkins
tools.description: Fetch a user's detailed check-ins (venue, date, comment) into the cache from user/checkins. Incremental and resumable: pages backwards up to max_pages per call, persisting progress every page; run again until another_run_needed is false. NOTE: Untappd only returns the ~50 most recent check-ins for accounts other than your own and will not page further — such a sync reports history_truncated and you should use untappd_sync_user_beers for full has-had coverage. backfill_complete is only reported once ~all of total_checkins is cached. Pass force_backfill: true to reset a cache wrongly marked complete and re-page the whole history (cached rows are kept). Stops BEFORE the ~100 calls/hour rate limit (or cleanly on a 429) with stopped_for_rate_limit and rate_limit.resume_at — progress is saved; re-run after that time. Omit username for your own account.

username.description: Untappd username. Omit to use your own configured account (UNTAPPD_USERNAME).

max_pages.description: Pages (50 check-ins each) to fetch this run (default 10). Keep modest to respect the ~100 calls/hour rate limit.

force_backfill.description: Reset the sync state (clear backfill_complete + cursors) but KEEP cached rows, then re-page the whole history from newest. Use to recover a cache wrongly marked complete.

annotations.title: Sync a user's check-ins into the cache

tools.name: untappd_sync_user_beers
tools.description: Fetch a user's COMPLETE distinct-beers list (every unique beer they've ever had, with their rating, times-had count, and first/last dates) into the cache from user/beers. This is the cheapest way to get full "has had" coverage — thousands of beers instead of tens of thousands of check-ins — and, unlike user/checkins, it pages fully for any public/friend account. Offset-paged and resumable: fetches max_pages per call and persists progress; run again until another_run_needed is false. Feeds the same untappd_cache_has_had / has_had_many / not_had tools. Stops BEFORE the ~100 calls/hour rate limit (or cleanly on a 429) with stopped_for_rate_limit and rate_limit.resume_at — progress is saved; re-run after that time.
